title: Coast Guard saves 3 from sinking vessel
description: A crew from Coast Guard Station Cortez, Florida, dewaters a 37-foot boat after it began taking on water eight miles west of Bean Point on Anna Maria Island, Fla., Aug. 31, 2014. Crew members from the station saved three people after they plugged a six-inch hole in the boat's hull and dewatered the boat. U.S. Coast Guard video.
